name: Call of Fire

angles.text: As an aspiring shaman, you prove your dedication to the elemental spirits of fire by carrying a sacred torch to an isolated peak in Loch Modan.
As a dwarf, you hear dwarven speech as the path leads beyond the Valley of Kings into the rugged crags of Khaz Modan.
Across Alliance lands, common travelers see only barren mountain stone. Keepers of the shrine guard ancient elemental secrets from ordinary eyes.

faq.answer: The Call of Fire is a trial for an initiate seeking to earn a fire totem. You travel into the crags of Loch Modan and bring the Torch of the Dormant Flame to Braldir Ashmantle at a sacred mountain peak.
faq.q: What is the Call of Fire quest?

faq.answer: Braldir Ashmantle guards the Shrine of the Dormant Flame high in the crags of Loch Modan. He turns away ordinary travelers and treasure seekers, and welcomes those who bear the Torch of the Dormant Flame.

aliases: where is shrine of the dormant flame
faq.answer: The Shrine of the Dormant Flame rests high in the crags of Loch Modan. A hidden path winds there beyond the Valley of Kings.
faq.q: Where is the Shrine of the Dormant Flame located?

aliases: what is the torch of the dormant flame
torch of the dormant flame purpose
faq.answer: Initiates carry the Torch of the Dormant Flame to show their earnest intent and readiness to commune with elemental fire. Braldir Ashmantle requires you to present it before granting an audience.
faq.q: What is the purpose of the Torch of the Dormant Flame?

aliases: why is the fire shrine in loch modan
faq.answer: You travel to Loch Modan because the secluded elemental peak that holds the Shrine of the Dormant Flame rises beyond the Valley of Kings, away from casual travelers.
faq.q: Why must the petitioner travel to Loch Modan?

faq.answer: After you reach Braldir Ashmantle and prove your intent with the torch, you kindle the shrine's brazier. You return with the flame burning and earn the totem of fire.
faq.q: How is the fire totem earned through this trial?

sections.body: To earn the totem of fire, you carry the unlit Torch of the Dormant Flame into the crags of Loch Modan. Beyond the stone carvings of the Valley of Kings, a steep path climbs to an isolated mountain summit. There the elements hold sway, far from the roads travelers know.
sections.title: The Path Beyond the Valley of Kings

sections.body: Braldir Ashmantle watches over the Shrine of the Dormant Flame on a high, windswept peak. Unprepared wanderers and fortune hunters find only silence and bare stone. But when you arrive as a true initiate bearing the sacred torch, Braldir reveals the elemental power sleeping within the shrine's brazier, waiting to be rekindled.
sections.title: The Shrine of the Dormant Flame

summary: You carry the Torch of the Dormant Flame through Loch Modan to seek Braldir Ashmantle. The trial tests whether an initiate is ready to wield elemental flame.
attribution: In-game quest text: Call of Fire
